unsupportedProps.name: actions
unsupportedProps.description:
Caller-supplied actions that replace the built-in comment button and inline composer.
Called with `{ close }`; `close` dismisses the popover through the same path as Escape
and an outside click, so `onClose` fires. When given, `onCommentSubmit` and `onExpand`
are never called, Enter and Space no longer expand the popover, and focus moves to the
first action when the popover opens.

unsupportedProps.name: onCancel
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the composer is canceled.

unsupportedProps.name: onClose
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the popover should close.

unsupportedProps.name: onCommentSubmit
unsupportedProps.description: Called when a comment is submitted.

unsupportedProps.name: onExitComplete
unsupportedProps.description:
Called once the popover's exit transition has genuinely finished and it
has fully unmounted from the layout (see `_internal/OVERLAY-POLICY.md` §
"Transition lifecycle"). This component intentionally never unmounts
ITS OWN root element while closing — `data-cinder-visible`/
`data-cinder-closing` drive the retained fade instead of an `{#if}` gate
— so a consumer that wraps this component in its own `{#if}` keyed
directly on the same state that flips `open` false would destroy the
whole component instance before its exit transition ever gets a chance
to play. Use this callback to decouple that wrapping condition from the
live open state: keep the consumer's own mount gate true until this
fires, then clear it.

unsupportedProps.name: onExpand
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the compact action expands into the composer.

unsupportedProps.name: position
unsupportedProps.description: Viewport-relative anchor point for the popover.
